subject: Re: Kickoff - staffing for dble
body:
Dmitri,

Staffing:
- Efe Lindqvist is on dble at 60% for May 2026 - the prototypical training rewrite is his and it has to be finished inside May for the June calibration numbers to mean anything. He drops to 30% in June and July.
- Carmen Reyes 35% across the window, method and the confidence-model training.
- Maren Zhou 40%, evaluation harness - expected calibration error, reliability diagrams, temperature-scaling baseline.
- Gustavo Moreau 25% from June, integration with the two internal classifiers.

Compute: 24 GPUs on titan-a100 best-effort. These are CIFAR-scale reproductions, then fine-tunes of existing internal models - nothing that needs a vulcan reservation.

The May dependency on Efe is the schedule's single point of failure. Flagging it now rather than in June.

Alina
